integrity: The proof is analytic and exact. It derives the reflected-hull volume from facet projections, uses the inverse regular-simplex Gram matrix, proves an equalization reduction in every chamber, and maximizes five explicit rational functions. The packaged verifier checks all radical arithmetic and derivative identities exactly; a floating-point convex-hull computation was only a nonproof consistency check.
scientific_limitations: The theorem resolves only the regular six-simplex support-reflection problem. It does not determine the optimum in dimensions \(n\ge7\), for nonregular simplices, or for transformations other than Euclidean orthogonal reflection. Literature searches cannot exclude an unindexed or differently phrased prior observation.
title: Exact reflection maximum for the regular six-simplex
